drafts.title: BlockChain-Cred: Immutable Timestamp Proof of Ownership
drafts.summary: Generates a cryptographic fingerprint timestamp on a public ledger at the time of document drafting, giving students an immutable, timestamped claim of original authorship.

drafts.title: Peersub-Audit: Blind Peer-Review Collusion Detector
drafts.summary: Analyzes similarity patterns within specific student cohorts during active peer-review assignments to catch unauthorized collaboration prior to final grading.

drafts.title: MathEquate: LaTeX & Mathematical Proof Normalizer
drafts.summary: Parses handwritten or LaTeX mathematical expressions into canonical abstract trees to catch copied proofs regardless of variable substitution.

drafts.title: ImageMatch-Academic: Figure & Chart Vector Matcher
drafts.summary: Extracts visual elements (diagrams, flowcharts, data graphs) and runs visual feature vector searches to catch cropped, recolored, or stolen figures.

drafts.title: ZeroTrust-Similarity: LSH Cryptographic Document Hasher
drafts.summary: Converts papers into Locality Sensitive Hashes (LSH) so institutions can match document similarity across campuses without storing or exposing raw, readable student files.

drafts.title: PatentMatch: Prior Art & Industrial IP Checker
drafts.summary: Indexes international patent offices (USPTO, WIPO) alongside academic literature for engineering, technology, and business capstones.

drafts.title: DataIntegrity: Fabricated Dataset & Synthetic Graph Detector
drafts.summary: Evaluates mathematical distributions (e.g., Benford's Law, uniform variance checks) in submitted CSV datasets to spot synthetic AI-generated experimental data.

drafts.title: SelfPlag-Finder: Institutional Intra-Student Indexer
drafts.summary: Compares a student's current submission strictly against their own prior coursework across past semesters to identify self-plagiarism.

drafts.title: ContextCite: NLP Citation Context & Semantic Auditor
drafts.summary: Checks whether the cited paper actually supports the statement made in the student's text, flagging misattributions and citation padding.

drafts.title: Citately: AI Hallucinated Citation & DOI Verifier
drafts.summary: Cross-references extracted bibliographies against live scholarly APIs (Crossref, OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar) to flag fake or hallucinated AI citations.

drafts.title: Oral2Text: Spoken Presentation & Viva Auditor
drafts.summary: Transcribes student presentation audio/video uploads and scans the spoken speech transcript against indexed literature for verbal plagiarism.

drafts.title: CodeSwitched-Plag: Mixed-Language Document Analyzer
drafts.summary: Evaluates multilingual documents containing code-switching (e.g., Taglish or Spanglish) by running language-specific NLP models in parallel across single paragraphs.

drafts.title: Translatio: Multi-Engine Back-Translation Detector
drafts.summary: Detects text that has been cycled through machine translation tools multiple times (e.g., English \rightarrow Spanish \rightarrow English) to obscure original source phrasing.

drafts.title: DialectMatch: Regional Repository & Vernacular Indexer
drafts.summary: Indexes regional university archives, local government reports, and non-digitized regional theses omitted by global platforms like Turnitin.

drafts.title: LinguaCheck: Multilingual Cross-Vector Matcher
drafts.summary: Uses dense cross-lingual vector embeddings (e.g., sentence-transformers) to detect semantic similarity across different languages (e.g., a Bisaya or Tagalog paper translated into English).

drafts.title: WatermarkScan: Statistical LLM Token Watermark Decoder
drafts.summary: Scans document matrices specifically for green-list/red-list token probability distributions left behind by official LLM watermarking protocols.

drafts.title: MultiLLM-Finder: Model Signature Classifier
drafts.summary: Classifies flagged text passages by their specific generative source (e.g., distinguishing between GPT-4, Claude, Gemini, and open-weight models).

drafts.title: PromptTrace: Reverse-Prompt Template Reconstruction Engine
drafts.summary: Uses language models to reverse-engineer flagged text and output the probable prompt template (e.g., "Write a 500-word essay about...") used to generate the submitted content.

drafts.title: BiasShield: ESL-Calibrated AI Sensitivity Adjuster
drafts.summary: Dynamically adjusts detection sensitivity thresholds based on Non-Native English (ESL) baseline profiles, reducing false positives caused by limited vocabulary variance.

drafts.title: XAI-Detect: Perplexity & Burstiness Statistical Inspector
drafts.summary: Replaces black-box percentage scores with per-sentence statistical metrics (entropy, perplexity, burstiness) to clearly explain why specific sentences were flagged.

drafts.title: FocusGrade: Active Session & Idle-Time Monitor
drafts.summary: Tracks active writing time versus passive window idle time within web-based writing environments to flag suspicious, near-instant document completions.

drafts.title: DocReplay: Google Docs & Word Version Graph Visualizer
drafts.summary: Ingests document revision histories and renders an animated step-by-step visual replay of document construction for rapid teacher auditing of bulk paste instances.

drafts.title: PasteGuard: Clipboard Telemetry & Source Attribution Engine
drafts.summary: Intercepts system clipboard actions inside the assignment editor, forcing students to select an attribution tag (e.g., "Direct Quote", "External Reference") whenever text blocks larger than 15 words are pasted.

drafts.title: AuthPulse: Biometric Typing Cadence Verifier
drafts.summary: Evaluates flight time and dwell time between keystrokes (keystroke dynamics) as a soft behavioral signature to confirm the enrolled student is the person actually typing the paper.

drafts.title: ReviseTrack: LMS Native Keystroke & Revision Plugin
drafts.summary: Integrates into Canvas or Moodle rich-text editors to record drafting session telemetry (typing speed, backspace frequency, paste events). Generates an auditable "Drafting Timeline" proving organic authorship.

drafts.title: SQL-Match: Database Schema & Query Normalizer
drafts.summary: Converts raw SQL queries and ER diagrams into canonical relational trees to identify copied database designs and query structures across student submissions.

drafts.title: NotebookTrace: Jupyter & Google Colab Session Auditor
drafts.summary: Analyzes cell execution count histories, execution timestamps, and kernel state metadata embedded in .ipynb files to verify whether a student incrementally wrote and tested their code.

drafts.title: AlgoGuard: Control-Flow Graph / CFG Similarity Scanner
drafts.summary: Generates visual execution paths and control-flow graphs (CFGs) to detect algorithmic logic plagiarism across different programming languages (e.g., Python code ported to C++).

drafts.title: ByteCheck: Compiler Bytecode & Intermediate Representation Matcher
drafts.summary: Compares compiled binaries and intermediate representations (e.g., LLVM IR, Java Bytecode) rather than raw text. Renders superficial code refactoring and syntax cosmetics completely irrelevant.

drafts.title: CodeProvenance: AST + Git Telemetry Engine
drafts.summary: Parses source code into Abstract Syntax Trees (ASTs) while tracking local Git commit timestamps and typing cadence. Detects structural logic cloning even if variable names, comments, and formatting are altered.
